doctor.expectedResult: OS, binaries, instances, roots and supported transport inventory; no browser mutation
doctor.verification: CIM process metadata and netstat listeners; not a browser health claim

profiles.expectedResult: Numbered directory IDs and optional display names; no profile creation
profiles.verification: Local State metadata and existing Preferences file; no cookie/password reads

preconditions: Loopback TCP CDP owned by that PID
CDP supports SystemInfo and browser command line or Chrome version profile-path proof
connect.expectedResult: Reused instance, verified endpoint and page target list; socket disconnected without browser.close
connect.verification: OS loopback listener/PID and explicit command-line root/profile; CDP browser PID plus command line, or native Chrome version-page profile path fallback (creates and closes a temporary verification tab)

preconditions: Same identity and connection preconditions as connect
tabs.expectedResult: Read-only page target IDs, titles and URLs
tabs.verification: Target.getTargets from the verified browser connection

preconditions: Explicit existing root and exact directory key
Optional HTTP(S) URL without credentials or exact about:blank; omitted URL defaults to about:blank
Matching inspectable TCP instance OR selected known executable and unused root
No implicit profile creation or default-root Chrome CDP launch
open.expectedResult: One new requested page (default about:blank) in reused or newly launched GUI browser; browser stays alive after CLI exit
open.verification: All connect checks + created target re-read + DOM location/readyState/body/title assertion + host window handle after operation

preconditions: Explicit target ID and expected exact URL
verify.expectedResult: Read-only DOM, target URL and current host window evidence
verify.verification: Separate CLI invocation can re-read same target after opener process exits

preconditions: CSS selector for fill/click; explicit value for fill
read.expectedResult: Read a bounded DOM snapshot of the selected target
read.verification: OS/CDP identity + expected URL + DOM snapshot; click outcome requires a subsequent read

preconditions: CSS selector for fill/click; explicit value for fill
fill.expectedResult: Fill a text input and verify its exact DOM value
fill.verification: OS/CDP identity + expected URL + DOM snapshot; click outcome requires a subsequent read

preconditions: CSS selector for fill/click; explicit value for fill
click.expectedResult: Dispatch a DOM-targeted mouse click; verify resulting state with read
click.verification: OS/CDP identity + expected URL + DOM snapshot; click outcome requires a subsequent read

preconditions: New absolute destination with existing parent; outside source
copy-profile.expectedResult: Best-effort selected-profile copy with file counts, omissions manifest and loginSession NOT_TESTED; source untouched
copy-profile.verification: Re-read copied Local State and Preferences; manifest describes omissions; no claim of atomic consistency or preserved login

unsupported.profileCreation: No implicit profile creation, deletion or seeding; explicit authorized copy-profile only
unsupported.sessionModification: No logout, browser restart/close, lock deletion or cookie decryption; copying preserves source bytes when readable but cannot promise login
unsupported.pipeTakeover: Reuse original client; this harness does not hijack remote-debugging-pipe
unsupported.personalChromeWithoutCdp: Default personal Chrome root cannot be launched through port; use explicitly authorized copy to a separate root. No autoConnect/Allow bypass. Beta unsupported.
unsupported.arbitraryExecutable: Unknown distributions are blocked rather than labeled Chrome/Chromium by guess
unsupported.generalAutomation: No arbitrary JS eval or desktop control; bounded read/fill/click only
unsupported.visualConfirmation: Window handle is not proof that user sees the interactive desktop
unsupported.guestSystemProfiles: Guest Profile and System Profile are excluded from selectable persistent profiles

evidenceRules.FAIL: Command/transport/verification failed; inspect effects before retry
evidenceRules.BLOCKED: Precondition or unsupported connection prevents action
evidenceRules.NOT_TESTED: Capability/environment or human observation not exercised

transports.cli: Implemented; requires authorized Windows host process/GUI/network context

mcpHost.commands: doctor, profiles, connect, tabs, open, verify, read, fill, click, copy-profile
mcpHost.antigravity: Preferred when run_command is isolated and CIM is blocked
mcpHost.verified: Five fresh Antigravity CLI conversations on 2026-11-15

chrome.transport: loopback TCP CDP; existing non-default root or authorized profile copy
